# AI Market Research Tool — Understand Any Market in Minutes, Not Weeks

 Generate comprehensive market analysis briefs with AI. Research market size, industry trends, competitive landscapes, customer segments, and growth opportunities — all structured into professional, citation-backed reports. 

An AI market analysis tool generates market analysis briefs — market sizing, competitive landscape, customer segments, and growth opportunities — through an 8-stage pipeline that checks your figures against the source documents you uploaded and adds automatic [1], [2] citations. Gixo's version turns this into a structured brief with 20+ semantic blocks (KPIs, Comparison Tables, Pros/Cons, CTAs) in minutes instead of the 1-2 weeks an in-house analyst or 4-8 weeks a research firm typically takes. Cited claims point to uploaded files, but the model can omit a marker. Review citations, source definitions and the proposed interpretation; brand checks do not establish factual accuracy.

As a market research tool, Gixo sits on the analysis side of the category rather than the data side. You bring the evidence — industry reports, analyst PDFs, survey and analytics exports, internal sales figures — and Gixo produces the written market research deliverable, with the figures in the draft reconciled against those uploads and [1], [2] citations attached.
